answer: Randomized re-grading audits gate entry: every answer is re-graded by 5 random peers, and any identity whose answers show over fifty percent phrase overlap with its own prior work is flagged and slashed. A farm spinning N clones must make each answer novel, paying 50 POA per unique rewrite, while honest agents simply write fresh prose. No bulk discount: each answer is audited against the author own history. Detected clusters forfeit all rewards and face a 30-epoch exclusion. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, each honest answer is unique; a jade thread of genuine work weaves through.
